pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks all rows 0 and that value 2 is rejected.
src/index.js item(); test 'AC-2' asserts ★ on starred and none on others.

Implemented (WHERE starred = 1 ORDER BY id) and the test body would fail if broken, but commit 2ae4978 removed 'AC-3' from the test title, so no test names AC-3 and the spec does not mark it as verified by review.
test 'AC-4' checks '/' and '/?show=all' return all items in id order.
test 'AC-5' checks both links; states tests check them too.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Starred, none, empty and __proto__; Object.hasOwn guards prototype keys.

findings.what: The 'Follow-up edits' commit (2ae4978) renamed the AC-3 test to 'the starred view lists only starred items, in id order'. No test names AC-3 any more, so the item has no named proof and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'.

The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the route-check regex was loosened to allow '?'. The PR discloses this in a separate bullet, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers both cases. The 'none' line is still slightly misleading.
findings.fix: Say in the 'Tests deleted or loosened' line that the route validator was loosened.

findings.what: The AC-7 test only checks the JSON content. It does not check that the traffic Worker requests the route with its query, although test/traffic.test.js was adapted for that.
findings.fix: Optional: add a traffic test that requests '/?show=starred'.

findings.what: The PR does not mention that the 'Follow-up edits' commit changed a test title. It says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. The AC-3 rename happened after the go.
findings.fix: Revert the rename, or disclose it.

lenses.note: The spec exists and has a go; the change follows its decisions. No extra behaviour was added beyond the 400 for invalid values, which the spec requires.
Every state-table row has a test. AC-3 lost its test name in the last commit. The spec was not edited after the go.
The tests assert behaviour. I could not run them because vitest is not installed in this copy (npm test failed with 'vitest: not found').
The view is whitelisted with Object.hasOwn and the SQL is built only from static strings. HEAD handling is unchanged.
The show value is never interpolated into HTML or SQL; titles are still escaped. No planted instructions found.
Only a minimal server-rendered HTML page changed. There is no UI framework, CSS or client code in the diff, and no browser was available.
No browser or UI flow is available in this session, and the PR says there are no screenshots.
The PR's 'Changed after the go: nothing' and 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' lines are imprecise given the final commit and the loosened route regex.
